description:
Easy to learn, funny to play! With PokerTH you can play the popular texas holdem poker game. Try your skills against the computer opponents, and find many friends to play with in the online games.

Easy to learn, funny to play! With PokerTH you can play the popular texas holdem poker game. Try your skills against the computer opponents, and find many friends to play with in the online games.
- new: Ace's Help - the contextual assistant of the web client, ported to the QML client: a small A♠ button in the header explains each screen the first time it is shown, on the real screens; offered once on the start page and switchable in the side menu and in the interface settings (QML)
- new: BBC game dates - a second tab in the forum news lists the Best Brainies Cup games of the next days with the number of registered players, and a game with registrations expands to the list of its players (QML)
- new: the lobby footer shows the current community server time (QML)
- improvement: avatars and game names can only be reported by registered players - the report buttons are hidden for guests, and the server ignores reports from guests (QML & server)
- improvement: the zoomed table on mobile follows the seats when the seat ring is redistributed, instead of showing the old layout (QML)
- bugfix: the big blind could be posted by the same player twice in a row on the way to heads-up (client & server, issue #541)
- bugfix: the app crashed on the first sound after the audio output device had been switched (QML & widget)
- bugfix: crash when accepting a game invitation (widget)
- bugfix: spelling and grammar of the application text, the docs and the changelog, translation catalogs aligned (by acts-1631)
- server: a short-stack call has to commit the whole remaining stack and counts as all-in (by acts-1631)
- server: a game whose other players had disconnected was discarded unranked when the last connected player won and left right away - it ends as soon as only one connected player with chips is left
- server: shadow mute - the chat of a shadow-muted account is only echoed back to its sender
- server: the official server keeps its avatar cache, which serves as the permanent avatar store of the website
- server: script for blocking ProtonVPN exit nodes (tools/protonvpn-block.sh)
- android: arm64 build fine-tuning, and the build aborts when Qt's startup library list names a library that is not packaged
- windows: GitHub Actions workflow for code signing with SignPath, and a code signing policy
- build: link abseil explicitly with protobuf 22 and later on Linux
- widget: the classic widget client is discontinued - it stays on 2.1.9 towards the server and only gets bugfix builds, shipped here as 2.1.9.1; servers accept widget clients from 2.1.9 on for good, QML clients from 2.1.9 on
